design.name: 马面狱卒
design.brief: Horse-Face (马面), the horse-headed jailer of Chinese folklore, now the warden of the fire god's prison: a tall lanky hunched figure about 2.1 m tall with a long grim horse head (a long black mane as a few big carved locks, flared glowing nostrils, big yellow teeth, small ember eyes), a lean muscular human body with charcoal-grey skin, a jailer's black short coat with a vermilion sash, wrapped trousers and a black official's cap with two short side flaps. On its LEFT forearm a huge heavy black-iron shackle cuff with a big glowing lava-orange lock core (锁芯, weak spot); a heavy iron chain riveted to that cuff is coiled several times around the forearm and ends in a big barbed soul-hook (勾魂钩). Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four long fingers; straw sandals showing five toes on each foot. Sinister and patient: it throws the chain hook and drags its victims in.
design.weapon: its soul-hooking chain unwinding from the shackle cuff on its left forearm, whirled overhead and thrown, the barbed hook glowing at the end (the chain comes out of the cuff; both hands are empty)
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_lead: SYMMETRIC bind pose for rigging (the thrown chain is a separate runtime effect and is NOT drawn uncoiled):
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright, feet a little apart, BOTH ARMS IN THE SAME MIRRORED A-POSE about 35 degrees away from the body, elbows slightly bent, both hands open and EMPTY with the fingers slightly spread; the iron shackle cuff on the left forearm with the chain coiled TIGHTLY around the forearm and the hook clipped flat against the cuff (nothing hanging, nothing dangling); the lock core painted as opaque glowing orange (no halo); the horse head facing straight ahead, mouth closed; the mane as big carved locks
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four long fingers, each foot with five toes visible in the straw sandals, clearly countable; the ears, cap and mane fully inside the frame.
